release_summary: Completes PR #4's focused corrections: case-insensitive RWA class gates, reference-aware source polling and bounded buff caches; verified Grid target preservation and one roster scan per refresh; daily-page marking after a valid shop-link handoff; cross-window chat drag cleanup; elapsed-time bank refreshes; safe missing KittyCombo range probes; and per-update pbInfo mouseover reuse. The 0.2-second Kitty dispatch window and earlier kit fixes carry forward. Combat throughput gains have not been measured.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 512 tests, 486 passed and 26 pre-existing skips. Focused checks cover target storage/restoration failures, class aliases and cache bounds, shop errors/timeouts, cross-window input, 15-144 FPS bank timing, missing range names, dispatch/action/resource/prediction parity and pbInfo snapshots. A read-only audit of 18 saved RWA definitions passed 3456 observation/load cases; none had class restrictions, so those are covered by dedicated fixtures. Native input, timing, browser handoff and successful-cast A/B measurements still need in-game validation.
